asset.name: InlineStatus
asset.description: The compact status region placed beside the control or content it concerns, covering loading, success, warning, failure, and retry without pulling the user's attention away from their work.

requires.reason: Certainty and urgency treatment is shared rather than reinvented per surface.
Copy uses the shared text styles rather than local typography.
Messages are announced through the one shared live region.

rationale: DESIGN.md's rule that inline feedback belongs near the action when the user must keep working. This is the asset that keeps routine outcomes out of the toast queue.
